primary_scope: test trackable subset (251 questions; main four dimensions 231; secondary ReID 20)

tests.mcnemar: Exact two-sided conditional binomial test of discordant paired correctness; discordant count zero gives p=1. No continuity correction.
tests.bootstrap: Paired question-level percentile 95% CI for accuracy(other)-accuracy(reference), 1000 resamples, numpy default_rng(42), sorted qa_id within each fixed subset. Question, not video, is the requested resampling unit.
tests.comparisons: A vs B, A vs C, A vs D: primary test trackable aggregate and each dimension; also main-four aggregate. H4 also B vs frozen rule; H5 uses guided predictions and one-sided exact binomial vs 0.25.
tests.multiplicity: Report unadjusted exact p values; additionally Holm-adjust the three aggregate A/B,C,D p values. Hypotheses are individually assessed at alpha .05; no claim of familywise significance for all per-dimension exploratory comparisons.
tests.positive_effect: Positive accuracy difference, exact two-sided paired p<.05 and paired bootstrap lower bound>0.
tests.null_caution: Failure to reject is not proof of equivalence or non-superiority; report uncertainty explicitly.

hypotheses.criterion: positive_effect criterion on B-A; strict official decoding

hypotheses.statement: C and A show no clear difference, addressing mention-of-tracker effects.
hypotheses.criterion: p>=.05 and CI includes 0 is compatible with H2 but is not equivalence proof; p<.05 contradicts H2; otherwise inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: D does not exceed A, addressing trajectory-format placebo.
hypotheses.criterion: Upper CI<=0 supports non-superiority; positive_effect contradicts H3; otherwise inconclusive (no inference from nonsignificance).

hypotheses.statement: B exceeds both A and the frozen rule.
hypotheses.criterion: positive_effect for both B-A and B-rule; conjunctive assessment.

hypotheses.statement: B exceeds A and random 25%; strict-only improvement is not evidence.
hypotheses.criterion: positive_effect on guided B-A, plus guided B accuracy>25% with one-sided exact binomial p<.05 and bootstrap accuracy lower bound>25%.

secondary_scopes: All 602 test questions; full 749 and full trackable 324 supplemental, development contributed to tuning.
numerical_main: Unconstrained official strict accuracy, plus exact stripped raw legality; constrained runs remain diagnostic.
evidence_examples: Per dimension, first five sorted test qa_id in each direction B-correct/A-wrong and B-wrong/A-correct; if fewer, include all available and state shortage. Include whole B track text and both raw model outputs; full-set additional cases separately if needed.
supplemental_template: Do not run until main results have been completed and reported.
